node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 diagonal c2 (1,1,2) source-line colored quotient compiler
node.closure: exact two-fiber colored-divisor descent and partial-resultant quotient system for saturated source-line (1,1,2) packets
node.statement: In every saturated source-line diagonal (1,1,2) packet, the four mixed common-K stars transport to all four universal I-J stars. They form exactly two complete unramified source fibers over Omega=tau(K_Lc), so C_H is proportional to chi_Omega(psi). Here Omega=J_1 in the aligned case and Omega={xi,ell} in the near-aligned case with tau(eta) in K. The partial resultants descend to Q_J proportional to K_5^2 chi_Omega and chi_Omega Q_I proportional to R_7^2. This is a quotient compiler, not a packet or row deletion.
